# Hand-curated core English vocabulary (base forms), used by scripts/build-dict-en.mjs as the
# primary ranking signal for the pruned CMUdict lexicon. Whitespace separated; lines starting
# with '#' are comments. Written independently of the evaluation corpus (scripts/lipsync-corpus.mjs):
# it is a general-purpose spoken-English core list (function words, everyday verbs, nouns,
# adjectives, numbers, time, family, food, places, feelings). Inflections (-s, -ed, -ing, -er,
# -est, -ly ...) are generated by the build script, so only base forms are listed here.
